description: This file defines the Skill class in the OrangeHRM system, extending ListableDisplayField to represent a skill display field in reports. It specifies the DTO class it uses, entity aliases, and relevant fields.

classes.name: Skill
classes.description: Represents a report display field for a skill, specifying the DTO class, entity aliases, and fields related to employees' skills.

methods.name: getDtoClass
methods.description: Returns the class name of the Data Transfer Object used for this display field.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns an array of entity aliases associated with this display field.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns an array of database fields associated with this display field.
